verdict.rationale: vLLM's official docs and README make package install the primary path: `uv pip install vllm --torch-backend auto`, or plain pip. Building from source is framed as an alternative "for development", and an official prebuilt Docker image (vllm/vllm-openai) is published on Docker Hub. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of prebuilt wheel coverage across the supported hardware backends (e.g., AMD, CPU, TPU), and no independent or hands-on corroboration that package installs work without compilation.
